pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Crafted at the Crafting Station. Blueprints unlock as your town levels up — 1, 5, 10, 20 and 30 each open a batch.$()$(br2)A wand is a mage's main-hand item, and the attribute bonus it carries only takes effect once it is equipped on a mage, boosting thing

s like spell power, work speed or max mana. The 12 preset wands each lean a different way, some toward combat and some toward buildin$(br2)g. You can pull a wand off one mage and hand it to another at any time, but a player holding one gains none of that.

A player holding a wand can also give orders to the town's mages: shift+right-click to switch modes, right-click to use the current o$(br)ne, and the current mode is written in the item tooltip (the head gem is coloured to match). Shelter and Hostile are the two that wor

k on creatures — one marks the target as an ally so your mages leave it alone, the other sends nearby mages to focus their fire on it$(br). Gather and Identify are the two that work on blocks — Gather calls nearby mages to the spot you point at, and Identify unlocks that$(br)block's crafting recipe on the spot.
